requirements_summary: Workload: live agent assist + post-call ticket summarization + automated tool-calls into internal CRM.
Traffic profile: 600 active agents normal, spikes to 2,400 agents during peak campaign windows (4x).
Latency SLOs: streaming proposal latency <80ms (token emit to agent), end-to-end suggestion delivery <200ms.
Throughput target: sustain 2,400 concurrent streaming connections with 50 RPS per agent (short prompts).
Quality controls: function calls for creating/updating tickets, deterministic templates for summarization, safety filters to suppress PII leaks.
Operational: per-route telemetry, token-level cost breakdown, per-agent tracing for debugging false-positives in guardrails.
poc_plan: Scope: 2-week POC, 10 live agents, routing via Dedicated pool in US-east and EU-west for residency test.
Goals: prove median streaming latency <100ms, validate fallback policy during induced capacity pressure, and test tool-calling fidelity to internal ticket API.
Steps: provide sample prompts/prompt-templates; Redwood to enable prefix KV caching + optimized kernel selection for selected model; run synthetic spike test (2.5k concurrent) mid-POC.
Success metrics: latency SLA met 95% of time, no dropped streaming connections, guardrail false-positive rate <3% on ticket fields, roundtrip tool-call success >99%.
Deliverables: performance report, configuration recommendations (batching/quantization), security artifact: SOC2 mapping + SAML integration checklist.
